title: Russia–Ukraine war
summary: The full-scale war is in its fifth year, with both sides striking each other's energy systems. After talks with Zelensky and European leaders in Oslo on 20 October, US envoy Witkoff took a framework proposal to Putin in St Petersburg on 21 October, where Russia freed American prisoner Stephen Hubbard. Washington has eased sanctions and is pressing Kyiv to settle; Europe accuses it of pushing Ukraine towards surrender.

background.text: Trump announces an 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine without published terms.
Trump waives nearly all measures in the Graham Act, a day before they were to take effect.
